generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one Minecraft weapon texture artwork. Image 1 is a STYLE reference ONLY: the red dark sword inside the video, ignore all website UI and words. Match its coarse deliberate square pixel clusters, restrained charcoal/plum body, broad clean painted highlight bands, hard stepped sharp silhouette and nearly flat thin fins. Texture defines shape, not stacked boxes. Flat orthographic view, no perspective, no lighting render, no glossy/PBR metal, no blur, bloom, gradients, antialiasing, tiny noise, or voxel cubes. Intended native artwork about 32x80 pixels enlarged with nearest-neighbor. One fully visible weapon with generous margin. Actual RGBA transparent background if possible; no painted checkerboard, shadow or extra props. No text/logos. An upright long recurved bow viewed from the SIDE, its whole dark curved limb profile visible. Both slender tips sweep toward the LEFT, the handgrip is at the farthest RIGHT at middle height. Charcoal and dark forest green limbs, a wide continuous moss-green stepped highlight ribbon following the outer bend, only a few pale yellow-green edge accents. Distinct wrapped central grip with a small green gem. Two asymmetric thin leaflike fin ornaments near the grip, not a chunky dragon head. Draw NO STRING and NO ARROW; the string will be a separate moving native model. Preserve a large open space left of the limb, not a filled shield or thick wooden bar.

edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: a weapon texture whose head mistakenly resembles a spear. Change ONLY the upper weapon head into a short, broad, heavy flanged MACE crown. Preserve the dark charcoal/plum body, broad teal highlight ribbons, muted brass socket, wrapped slender handle and decorated lower pommel. Head WIDTH should be greater than head HEIGHT; remove the long pointed central spear spike entirely. Four broad striking flanges surround a small hollow diamond with teal crystal, top has short blunt crown teeth, side flanges end in substantial stepped striking corners, not long points. The result must read as a heavy mace, never a spear, sword or staff. Match the existing coarse square painted pixel clusters, hard stepped silhouette, thin fin material finish; no stacked voxel boxes, no glossy/PBR render, blur or antialiasing. Flat front orthographic view, entire weapon visible, unchanged handle proportions, transparent RGBA background if possible, no painted checkerboard, shadows, labels or extra props.
edit.status: selected for review; shorter crown improves blunt silhouette, not final quality approval
